limitations: Floor candidates are predeclared alternatives. Choosing a floor after inspecting the same outcomes does not create a jointly selectable confidence family.
Projected future successes retain E83 rates and round to integer counts; they are planning sensitivity, not new measured paths.
The residual optimization minimizes E99's mean-width surrogate, not exact p90 or maximum robust regret.
Cellwise binomial and rectangular-confidence limitations from E96 remain.
The audit is local statistical analysis and is not new GPU evidence.
model: Reserve a preregistered share of every additional path budget using E98 linear mean-contrast weights, then minimize E99's mean-width surrogate over the remaining budget. Zero floor reproduces E99 and full floor reproduces E98.
